review.reason: The running mean loses small contributions during cancellation. For example, inputs 1e100, 1, -1e100 have mean 0.333333, but the intermediate rounding discards the 1 and cannot recover it. The evaluator misses this case. Changes are within scope and show no evaluator gaming, but numerical correctness needs improvement.

worker.summary: Updated only stats.c with strict finite decimal/scientific parsing using strtold, overflow-aware online mean calculation, and six-decimal output. Empty and invalid inputs fail. evaluate.py is preserved. Runner check passed 12/12; additional focused executions were blocked because run requires --allow-exec.

review.reason: parse() rejects every ERANGE result, including finite subnormal values and underflow to zero. Thus valid decimal inputs such as 1e-99999 fail instead of producing 0.000000. Reject overflow and nonfinite results while allowing finite underflow. Changes are implementation-only with no apparent evaluator gaming. This finding is from static review; no check tool was available.
